intended_application: Autonomous Customer Support Triage and Instant Refund Execution
business_need: Resolving customer order inquiries, issuing autonomous refunds/replacements, and updating CRM tickets 24/7 without human intervention.
users_stakeholders: Online retail shoppers, customer experience managers, and e-commerce operations.
adoption_posture: Moderate / fast-follower; seeks cost-per-ticket reduction and customer satisfaction gains without building proprietary models.
capabilities_constraints: Shopify/Zendesk cloud stack, tight unit-economics margins per support ticket, and high seasonal traffic spikes.
risk_consequence_context: Moderate financial and reputational risk; unauthorized refunds or prompt-injection coupon exploits directly impact profit margins.
management_question: How does Agentic AI compare against traditional rule-based CX chatbots and SaaS plugins right now, and what market signals should trigger a switch?
